alcohol.answer: JAL allows alcohol in carry-on or checked baggage: drinks of 24% or less have no limit, drinks above 24% and under 70% are limited to five litres per person, and anything over 70% is prohibited.

sections.h: 🍷 What Japan Airlines says about alcohol
sections.p: From the JAL international-flights page "About the restricted articles in checked and carry-on baggage", read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
JAL rule
rows: Prohibited in carry-on and checked baggage
Carry-on or checked; JAL strongly recommends glass bottles go in carry-on because they are fragile
On international flights containers must hold 100 ml or less, in one transparent re-sealable bag of up to one litre

list: Not on the page: the section read does not explain how bottles bought at foreign duty-free shops are handled at a Japanese connection.

faq: How much alcohol can I take on a JAL international flight?
No limit up to 24% alcohol; five litres per person above 24% and under 70%; over 70% is prohibited.
Should I pack a glass bottle in carry-on or checked bags on JAL?
JAL allows both but strongly recommends carry-on for glass bottles because they are fragile.
